parts.name: Seat
parts.Basic_description: The seat of the folding chair is a flat wooden surface designed to support the user's weight. It is rectangular and attached to the folding frame.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the main sitting surface for the user and supports the body weight when the chair is in use.
parts.Movement_description: It folds upward or downward along a hinge mechanism to allow the chair to collapse for storage.

parts.name: Backlegs
parts.Basic_description: The backlegs are the rear structural supports of the folding chair, made of wood and connected to the seat and base frame.
parts.Functional_description: They provide stability and support to the chair, bearing part of the user's weight and maintaining balance.
parts.Movement_description: They pivot around a hinge joint to fold inward when the chair is collapsed.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main frame of the folding chair, forming the front legs and backrest support structure.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the main structural integrity of the chair, connecting all other parts and ensuring stability during use.
parts.Movement_description: It serves as the pivoting frame that allows the chair to fold and unfold smoothly.
